test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 16 Jun, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Who among the following is NOT eligible for the subsidy under the PMAY-U 2.0 scheme launched in 2024?

options.text: Middle Income Groups (MIG) having an annual income of up to ₹9 lakh per year
Individuals with annual income up to ₹6 lakh
Families given housing by any government scheme in the past 20 years

solution:
The correct answer is __**Families given housing by any government scheme in the past 20 years**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The PMAY-U 2.0 scheme, launched in 2024, aims to provide affordable housing to urban dwellers from specific income groups.
 
• Eligibility under the scheme includes individuals from Economically Weaker Sections (EWSs) and Middle Income Groups (MIG) with annual incomes up to ₹9 lakh.
 
• Families or individuals with annual income up to ₹6 lakh are eligible under the Lower Income Group (LIG) category.
 
• However, families already provided housing under any government scheme in the past 20 years are **excluded** from PMAY-U 2.0 eligibility.
 
• This exclusion ensures that the scheme benefits only first-time beneficiaries and avoids duplication of housing benefits.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **PMAY-U (Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Urban):**

 
 
• A flagship scheme by the Government of India to ensure "Housing for All" by 2024.
 
• Focuses on providing affordable housing in urban areas through Credit Linked Subsidy Scheme (CLSS).
 
 
 
• **Economically Weaker Sections (EWSs):**
 
 
• EWS households have an annual income of up to ₹3 lakh.
 
• They are eligible for the highest subsidy under PMAY-U.
 
 
 
• **Middle Income Group (MIG):**
 
 
• MIG households are divided into two categories: MIG-I (₹6–₹9 lakh annual income) and MIG-II (₹9–₹12 lakh annual income).
 
• They are eligible for varying levels of interest subsidy on housing loans.
 
 
 
• **Credit Linked Subsidy Scheme (CLSS):**
 
 
• Under CLSS, beneficiaries can avail interest subsidies on home loans for construction, purchase, or improvement of their houses.
 
• The subsidy amount depends on the income group of the applicant.
